# `csharp_trailing_comma_in_multiline_lists`

Add a trailing comma after the last element of a list that breaks across lines.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

### `csharp_trailing_comma_in_multiline_lists = true`

```ini
csharp_trailing_comma_in_multiline_lists = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int[] Make()
    {
        return new int[]
        {
            1,
            2,
            3
        };
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public int[] Make()
    {
        return new int[]
        {
            1,
            2,
            3,
        };
    }
}
```
:::

::::
